# ExBOS — Excellence Business Operations System (by PYLARIX)

> Rwanda's #1 all-in-one business management, POS, stock inventory, MTN MoMo & Airtel Money cash-flow, WhatsApp Business POS automation, RRA tax-ready invoicing, and multi-branch profit operating system for SMEs across Rwanda and East Africa.

## Core Public Pages
- [Home](https://exbos.pages.dev/): Platform overview, 6 business architectures, WhatsApp Business POS, and financial survival tools.
- [Features](https://exbos.pages.dev/features): Where Is My Money 8-bucket cash/MoMo/bank tracker, WhatsApp Business POS & debt reminders, multi-branch stock transfers, RRA VAT 18% / EBM readiness, and live P&L reports.
- [Business Models](https://exbos.pages.dev/business-models): Six dedicated industry workspaces in one platform.
  - [Make & Sell (Manufacturing, Bakery, Tailoring)](https://exbos.pages.dev/business-models/make-and-sell)
  - [Buy & Sell (Retail, Wholesale, Pharmacy, Electronics)](https://exbos.pages.dev/business-models/buy-and-sell)
  - [Service-Based Businesses (Clinics, Salons, Repairs, Agencies)](https://exbos.pages.dev/business-models/services)
  - [Agriculture & Livestock (Farms, Dairy, Poultry, Agribusiness)](https://exbos.pages.dev/business-models/agriculture)
  - [Food & Hospitality (Restaurants, Cafes, Hotels, Lodges)](https://exbos.pages.dev/business-models/food-and-hospitality)
  - [Hybrid Business (Multi-Activity Enterprises)](https://exbos.pages.dev/business-models/hybrid)
- [Free Business Survival Tools](https://exbos.pages.dev/business-tools): 6-Month Business Survival Planner, Break-Even Calculator, Pricing & Margin Calculator in RWF.
- [Pricing (RWF)](https://exbos.pages.dev/pricing): Forever Free (0 RWF), Bronze Growth (10,000 RWF/mo), Silver Enterprise (20,000 RWF/mo), and Gold Corporate (35,000 RWF/mo).
- [About PYLARIX & ExBOS](https://exbos.pages.dev/about): Mission, Kigali headquarters, and bilingual English & Kinyarwanda SME focus.
- [Resources & Guides](https://exbos.pages.dev/resources): SME financial survival guides, inventory best practices, and RRA tax readiness.
- [Create Free Account](https://exbos.pages.dev/register): 7-step guided onboarding via Web or ExBOS Official WhatsApp (+250 792 946 680).
- [Sign In](https://exbos.pages.dev/login): Access your ExBOS workspace.
